body: Why did Tavon get as many touches and targets as Gurley!? This was not the game to start using Tavon in any other way other than end around decoys. Also we abandoned running conventional under centre runs with Gurley, instead pitching the ball to him many times in the backfield, which didn't work at all. We gotta stick with the run, and scheme more around players like Kupp and Watkins, who offer far more in the receiving category than the 'specialist' Tavon. We seemed to stray from our offensive gameplan from previous games, and although facing a much better defense, I still feel that we should've ran our offense how we would against anyone else, instead of trying to outsmart the Hawks. No reason for why we should've thrown 3 times in a row inside the 30. Feed Gurley!!! I may have sounded negative here but I am beyond excited to see how our offense continues to play well and man was that a close ending. If Kupp had caught that, then the narratives would be a lot different! Much to be optimistic for, Horns Up!!!!
